title: Stonecutter Smooth Stone
description: Gives smooth stone the texture that is used on the bottom of the stonecutter.
body:
![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d332cdab77737cd016fd7c1ae13efef260cbc7_0.webp)

**Stonecutter Smooth Stone** gives smooth stone the texture used on the bottom of the stonecutter. Smooth stone and smooth stone slabs have also been given a mirrored variant, similar to the way stone works, and can be removed by deleting the blockstates folder.

![optional](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a868b69f3fcafea77190464ed6cba5ded63d8581_0.webp)


<details>
<summary>Alternative Textures</summary>

![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18d1fa2298e1763648a262274d24087579483f9e_0.webp)

  Alternative textures can be found in the textures folder to replace the default ones.

</details>
